sources.title: abliteration.org - catalog of abliterated LLMs
sources.snippet: abliteration.org is an independent catalog and analytics resource for the abliterated and uncensored language-model market. Every model is registered with a precise timestamp and an inventory number, and the whole dataset is refreshed continuously.

sources.title: An "uncensored" 27B open-weight model claiming near-frontier reasoning ...
sources.snippet: The play An uncensored 27B model with near-frontier reasoning at 4-bit is pulling half a million downloads, useful for cost-sensitive internal tasks where content policy doesn't matter. A 27-billion-parameter model called Qwen3.6-27B-Fable-Fusion just hit 552,026 downloads on Hugging Face with almost no press coverage.
